default_request_policy.upstream: AI clients may send rich intent fields whenever available.
default_request_policy.router: OumuQ keeps the canonical fields, resolves character defaults, and forwards supported or harmless fields to workers.
default_request_policy.worker: Each worker maps, ignores, or degrades fields according to its engine/model capability.

mapping.character_id: registry lookup: api_voice_id, api_target_model (legacy api_clone_target_model fallback), speech_language, api_voice_instructions
mapping.instructions: SpeechSynthesizer instruction when send_instructions is true
mapping.emotion_vector: degrade to instruction + speech_rate + pitch_rate + volume
mapping.emotion_tags: degrade to instruction + speech_rate + pitch_rate + volume

notes: Voice enrollment needs a provider-accessible audio URL.
CosyVoice enrollment samples should be 15-20 seconds; OumuQ caps max_prompt_audio_length at 20.
Use cloned voice_id for timbre; use instruction/prosody controls for emotion.

mapping.emotion_vector: not guaranteed; prefer text style prompt or engine-specific controls
native or worker-specific emotion vector when supported by the running worker
keep as high-level Agent intent; do not forward as a provider field

notes: Voice design creates an original voice from a Chinese or English description and does not upload reference audio.
Enrollment and synthesis target models must match exactly.

mapping.reference_audio_path: Base64 Data URL during authorized enrollment only
mapping.emotion_vector: keep as high-level Agent intent; do not forward as a provider field

notes: Only use reference audio that the user explicitly has rights to submit for cloud voice cloning.
Enrollment and synthesis target models must match exactly.

playback_policy.order: route submission sequence within one OumuQ process
